This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]]''' was the son of the leader of the [[Council of Elders (Yinchorri)|Council of Elders]] of the Yinchorri city of [[Tol-Kachorn]], the strongest of the city-states on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. He lived during the times of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="AAUAA">''[[Alien Anthology]]'' and ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

During his lifetime, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] devastated Yinchorr, annihilating all the lifeforms there. A number of Yinchorri, including this individual, survived by leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] before that point.<ref name="AAUAA" />

Eventually, in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the New Republic expelled the Empire from Yinchorr. This individual raised the banner of Tol-Kachorn and became the new leader of the Yinchorri in their effort to re-build their civilization. Following him, the Yinchorri settled in a building established by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]].<ref name="AAUAA" />
